NDT training near North Charleston: Lowcountry employers, Carolina colleges and online study compared

The Lowcountry's NDT jobs sit in aircraft production, shipyard and naval work, the port, and the manufacturers that have grown up around them. Searching "NDT certification near me" from North Charleston, Summerville or Goose Creek turns up few local classrooms, because the region's colleges concentrate on aircraft maintenance, assembly and manufacturing rather than NDT itself. Here is what is actually available and how the routes compare.

Who offers NDT training around North Charleston?

  • Trident Technical College. Its S.C. Aeronautical Training Center teaches aircraft maintenance, avionics maintenance, aircraft assembly, mechatronics and machining, with noncredit quality control among its workforce courses. NDT is not listed as a program there. It is relevant groundwork for aerospace roles; ask whether a course includes inspection methods before counting any of it toward NDT hours.
  • Dedicated NDT programs in North Carolina. The nearest full NDT program we found is Central Piedmont Community College's nondestructive examination associate degree in Charlotte, a drive of roughly three and a half hours, taught in a hybrid format. Guilford Technical Community College near Greensboro runs shorter continuing-education method courses.
  • Contractors hiring for shipyard work. A 2026 Applied Technical Services listing for shipyard ultrasonic work near Charleston asked for Level II UT shear wave, a certificate of completion for UT Level I and Level II classroom training meeting SNT-TC-1A, on-the-job training signed off by an SNT-TC-1A Level III or supervisor, an extensive background check and US person status, with NAVSEA experience preferred. That list is a good map of what your training record has to show.
  • ASNT networking. ASNT's section listing includes a Coastal Georgia section and two sections linked to South Carolina, Piedmont and Central Savannah River Area, none of them based in Charleston.

Which North Charleston route fits you?

BackgroundRouteCheck
No NDT experienceAn assistant or trainee role with a contractor, with classroom hours studied alongsideThat every supervised hour is logged and signed
Leaving the Navy with technical trainingMap your service training against SNT-TC-1A, then a method course to fill gapsKeep your service training records; an employer's Level III decides what counts
Technician chasing shipyard UT rolesUT Level I and Level II classroom training with a completion record, then logged OJTWhether the yard works to NAVSEA procedures
Employer certifying a crewTraining at your facility, with exams set and graded by a Level IIIA written practice ready before the exams begin

Questions to ask any NDT training provider near North Charleston

  1. Will I receive a certificate of completion listing topics and hours for each method and level, the document shipyard listings ask for?
  2. Do those hours meet SNT-TC-1A for my target level? Run your own numbers with the SNT-TC-1A eligibility checker.
  3. Where does the practical happen, and on which instruments and specimens?
  4. Who certifies me at the end? Under SNT-TC-1A your employer does; ASNT does so only after its central exams.
  5. Can I put questions to a Level III during the course, and who signs the training record?

Where Atlantis fits for North Charleston candidates and employers

Atlantis NDT has no classroom in the Lowcountry. Method theory is self-paced on the Atlantis portal, open from the day you enroll and available all year, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions, and the training record lists topics and hours. You rehearse scans in the Practical NDT simulator, then do the hands-on practical and practical exam at your employer's facility under its written practice built on SNT-TC-1A. For shipyard UT roles the courses that matter are ultrasonic testing training at Level 1 and Level 2.

A contractor's assistant can study our theory between assignments so the classroom record keeps pace with field hours. Lowcountry employers can have training delivered at their own site. Welding staff can compare AWS CWI exam prep in North Charleston; nearby pages cover Savannah, Aiken and Charlotte, and the state picture is on the South Carolina page.
